description: The Festive Fancy duvet set is here to sweeten the season with its pastel-wrapped print and reversible bright stripes. Brimming with festive flair and made from sustainable polycotton, this modern design adds conscious yet playful style to your Yule-loving décor. 52% recycled polyester, 48% BCI cotton. Single includes 1 pillowcase, double, king size, and super king include 2 pillowcases. Popper fastening. Machine washable.
